name: Hybrid Gradient Volume Raycasting with Lasso Masking
definition: A volume raycasting technique that uses pre-computed HU gradients for lighting direction but only applies Phong lighting when a significant opacity change is detected along the gradient direction, combined with lasso-based voxel masking and cutting cube bounds.
summary: Hybrid Gradient Volume Raycasting uses pre-computed Hounsfield Unit gradients for lighting and lasso masking to selectively render regions of interest while preventing shading artifacts on smooth structures.
